en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic industrial view of a port city with rail tracks, warehouses, stacked lumber, and a tall smokestack dominating the middle. In the distance is a large grain-elevator‑type building and a spread of low houses with hills behind. There are two old postage stamps and circular postmarks in the upper right. Russian text is printed at the top left, likely giving the city name and identifying the elevator structure.
